## prerequisites

Check a cluster against the prerequisites a Zarf package declares.

Include it as `colonel_byte.zarf.prerequisites`.

Added in `colonel_byte.zarf` 0.33.0.

Reads a `colonel-byte.dev/v1alpha1` `PackagePrerequisites` document out of a package's documentation layer, reads the cluster with `colonel_byte.zarf.zarf_cluster_info`, and fails the play when the cluster does not satisfy the document.

This is the check that belongs in front of `colonel_byte.zarf.zarf_package_deploy`. A workload package deployed onto a cluster whose GitOps engine is absent is accepted, reported as a success, and never reconciled; the point of the document is to turn that into a refusal.

Supply the package in `zarf_package` and the role extracts its document, or supply the document directly in `zarf_prerequisites` for a package that carries none.

Sets the `zarf_prerequisites_document`, `zarf_prerequisites_checked`, `zarf_prerequisites_unmet`, and `zarf_prerequisites_skipped` facts. A package carrying no document is not a failure: nothing is checked and `zarf_prerequisites_checked` is empty.

`requires.storage.accessModes` is reported in `zarf_prerequisites_skipped` rather than checked. What a provisioner will bind is not discoverable without creating a PersistentVolumeClaim, and a check that cannot be made is better named than quietly passed.

Every task carries `run_once: true` and delegates to `zarf_delegate_to`.

### Variables

| Variable                     | Type   | Default     | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ---------------------------- | ------ | ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `zarf_package`               | `str`  | `""`        | The package whose prerequisites are checked: a path to a staged tarball, an `oci://` reference, or a deployed package name. Not required when `zarf_prerequisites` supplies the document directly.                                                                                             |
| `zarf_prerequisites`         | `dict` | `{}`        | A prerequisites document supplied directly, instead of being read out of a package. For a bundle whose requirements are known to the playbook rather than to the packages in it, or a package built before the format existed. When set, `zarf_package` is not inspected.                      |
| `zarf_public_key`            | `str`  | `""`        | Path to the public key the package's signature is verified against.                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `zarf_verify`                | `str`  | `""`        | When to verify the package signature. Left empty, the role requires a signature when `zarf_public_key` names a key, and leaves zarf's own `if-possible` default alone when it does not. Set it explicitly to override. One of ``, `never`, `if-possible`, `always`.                            |
| `zarf_kubeconfig`            | `str`  | `""`        | Path to the kubeconfig file the cluster is read through.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `zarf_binary`                | `str`  | `zarf`      | Path to the `zarf` binary on the delegated host.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `zarf_check_packages`        | `bool` | `true`      | Whether to check `requires.packages` against the cluster's deployed packages. It is the one check that needs a second query, and `zarf package list` needs an initialised cluster, so it can be turned off for a run that has not initialised one yet.                                         |
| `zarf_prerequisites_enforce` | `bool` | `true`      | Whether an unsatisfied prerequisite fails the play. Set it false to report rather than enforce: every check still runs and `zarf_prerequisites_unmet` still lists what failed, and the play continues. That is what a survey across a fleet of clusters wants, and what a deployment does not. |
| `zarf_quiet`                 | `bool` | `true`      | Whether to suppress verbose assert output when asserting inputs.                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `zarf_delegate_to`           | `str`  | `localhost` | The node on which to run zarf.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
